parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time as a timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The source of the security score. If left empty, the default value is Security Center. Valid values:

0: Security Center.

1: Alibaba Cloud ApsaraDB console.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time as a timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.
